items.stem: Which statements about limited liability are correct? (Select TWO)

options.text: It generally limits owners' losses to what they invested
options.rationale: Correct: shareholders are typically not liable beyond their investment.

options.text: It does not protect against personal fraud or wrongful acts
options.rationale: Correct: courts can look past the company for personal misconduct.

options.text: It makes owners immune from all legal consequences
options.rationale: Personal wrongdoing and guarantees can still create liability.

options.text: It applies automatically to a sole trader
options.rationale: A sole trader has unlimited personal liability.

items.explanation: Correct: shareholders are typically not liable beyond their investment.

items.stem: A manager reuses photographs found online in a paid advertisement without permission. What is the main legal risk?

options.rationale: Correct: images are usually protected by copyright regardless of being online.

options.text: No risk, because online content is public domain
options.rationale: Being online does not place work in the public domain.

options.text: Only a risk if the images are watermarked
options.rationale: Protection does not depend on a visible watermark.

options.text: A trademark violation unrelated to the images
options.rationale: The core issue is copyright, not trademark.

items.explanation: Correct: images are usually protected by copyright regardless of being online.
